card.name: Route or group adjective before a noun
card.fires_on: Qualifying adjectives such as systemic, oral, female, human or aqueous that stand right before a noun like treatment, dose or infertility. They often follow a contrast, such as between water and sediment, or a phrase like long-term.

modes.label: Route of administration
modes.description: The word oral or systemic comes before a drug-use noun such as treatment, use or administration.
modes.example: Long-term<< oral>> use has been associated with an increased risk

modes.label: Other qualifying adjectives
modes.description: Words like female, human, aqueous or water that name a category before the noun they qualify.
